name: IronClaw Memory Loop (Phase 3)
description: Phase 3: IronClaw reads a file, analyzes it, and writes a reflection to its persistent memory in Setec. On subsequent runs, the agent receives its previous notes and should demonstrate learning by building on them.
process: You MUST use the exec tool to call rj-tool for EVERY operation. Do NOT guess or fabricate file contents.
STEP 1: Read the target file. Execute: exec({"command": "/workspace/bin/rj-tool github_fetch owner=tinyland-inc repo=remote-juggler path=gateway/resolver.go"})

STEP 2: Analyze the file. Count the exported functions, identify any patterns (error handling, naming conventions, test coverage gaps). Be specific — cite line numbers or function names from the actual content you read.

STEP 3: Check your Notes from Previous Runs section (if present). Do NOT repeat observations you already made. Instead, build on them — go deeper, find new patterns, or verify whether previous observations still hold.

STEP 4: Write a reflection to your persistent memory. The reflection MUST include: (a) date and run context, (b) what you observed (with specific evidence from the file), (c) what you learned that you didn't know before, (d) rules for next time. Execute: exec({"command": "/workspace/bin/rj-tool juggler_setec_put name=remotejuggler/agents/ironclaw/memory value=<YOUR_REFLECTION>"})
STEP 5: Report a brief summary of what you did and what you wrote to memory.

metrics.successCriteria: Agent read a real file, wrote substantive memory to Setec, and on subsequent runs demonstrates learning by referencing previous notes.
